title: PractitionerOutreachListResponse
description: Paginated envelope of outreach records for a practitioner or facility credentialing workflow

data.description: Outreach records for this workflow, ordered by creation date descending

totalCount.description: Total number of outreach records matching this workflow

page.description: Current page index. Always 0 - pagination is not yet supported

size.description: Page size. Always 100 - a hardcoded ceiling; records beyond this are not returned

OutreachReasonWithLabel.description: Outreach reason with ID and label

id.description: Unique identifier for the outreach reason

label.description: Display label for the outreach reason

tenantId.description: Tenant that owns this outreach record

workflowId.description: Credentialing workflow (practitioner or facility) this outreach was sent for

outreachType.description: Outreach category this record was created for

reasons.description: Outreach reasons with their display labels

active.description: Whether this outreach is still open/awaiting a response

attemptsCount.description: Number of outreach emails sent for this record

lastAttemptedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent outreach attempt

workflowStatus.description: Status of the referenced credentialing workflow at the time of this response

outreachPage.description: Signed provider-portal link where the provider submits a response to this outreach. Present only when the tenant has the provider portal enabled, the outreach is still awaiting a response, and an outreach email exists to thread the submission onto; otherwise null.

createdBy.description: User ID that created this outreach record

createdByName.description: Display name of the user that created this outreach record

createdAt.description: Timestamp this outreach record was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp this outreach record was last updated

participatingTenants.description: Tenant ids this outreach was sent for, captured at send time (shared credentialing sends). Omitted for single-tenant outreaches; use tenantId instead.

subject.description: Subject of the outreach's latest outbound email. Present only in the shared credentialing listing (includeAllParticipatingTenants=true).

toAddresses.description: To recipients of the outreach's latest outbound email. Present only in the shared credentialing listing (includeAllParticipatingTenants=true).

ccAddresses.description: CC recipients of the outreach's latest outbound email. Present only in the shared credentialing listing (includeAllParticipatingTenants=true).
